title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-19
lineage: AUD > MC > Reel > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with a solid electric set and standout NFA > Lovelight, but the acoustic portion is thin and some high‑end distortion is present.
ai_review.review: The show captures a high‑spirited August 1970 performance – the electric half is hot and features a memorable Not Fade Away into Lovelight sequence, while the acoustic side suffers from weak pickup and organ being barely audible. Recording quality is decent for an audience tape with clear electric sections but occasional distortion that may need EQ tweaking.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews highlight several standout performances (NFA > Lovelight, Cryptical/Other One) and a generally good electric set, offset by acoustic recording issues and a flubbed Hard to Handle start; overall rating falls in the good‑to‑very‑good range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Electric portion loud and clear; acoustic section thin, organ barely audible. Some high‑end distortion noted; EQ adjustment may improve clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A spirited August show with a concise, high‑energy electric set that shines despite the acoustic portion being hampered by recording limitations.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's piano comes through strongly on the acoustic songs; organ is barely audible in this audience tape.
